_about: n-Undecane (1) + o-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 10.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n-undecane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n-undecane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Yang, S.[Shengkai], Zhu, F.[Fangkun], Zhu, Y.[Yong], Qiao, M.[Meiying], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for n-undecane + p-, o-, m-xylene at 10 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 360 (2013) 451-455
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 15, 16. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0017. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.30 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
